name: techtide-harness-kit
description: Open, portable, eval-backed skills for enterprise agents. Includes 348 agents, 487 skills, enterprise missions, and trust evidence across cloud, Kubernetes, Terraform, and AI harness lanes.

interface.shortDescription: Eval-backed enterprise agent marketplace for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Curated cloud, security, compliance, platform, and AI-harness agents for AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud, OVHcloud, Scaleway, Hetzner, Contabo, IONOS, Kubernetes, Terraform, NVIDIA, and enterprise implementation missions. Includes provider maestros, live-mutation guards, trust metadata, and eval evidence that enforce approval, target confirmation, evidence capture, and rollback before any live cloud mutation. For the full catalog of agent adapter files (.codex/agents/*.toml), run `npx thk-export-agents --platform codex --all --repo .` after installing this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Audit my AWS IAM policies for least-privilege violations.
Review this Terraform plan for blast radius and deletion risk.
